spots.text: LOST PROPERTY. EVERYTHING ARRIVES HERE EVENTUALLY.

secrets.name: The Ring Under the Floor
secrets.text: Down the ladder, through a low door, and under the tilted floor there is a round room of everything the drain has swallowed, dried out and shelved. Someone has been sleeping on the cushions.

meta.label: The Drain
meta.blurb: The floor of this room tilts, very gently, toward a hole in the middle. Everything in it has been sliding that way for a long time. You keep one hand on the rail without meaning to.
